subject.title: [security] Bearer-token redaction misses colon and line-folded forms in diagnostics

question: Should Crabbox patch the public bearer-redaction gap now in both the Worker and Go diagnostic helpers, and treat it as security-sensitive release work?
rationale: Source inspection supports the gap, but the exact regex expansion and disclosure/release handling touch Crabbox's documented credential-redaction boundary.

options.title: Patch both helpers now
options.body: Update both diagnostic redactors and add focused regression tests while preserving non-secret routing context.

options.title: Coordinate security release first
options.body: Hold implementation until maintainers decide disclosure timing, release notes, and any backport expectations.

options.title: Accept current coverage
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally limit bearer redaction to standard `Bearer <token>` and structured authorization-header forms.

recommendation.title: Patch both helpers now
recommendation.body: Update both diagnostic redactors and add focused regression tests while preserving non-secret routing context.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the recent merged Worker and Go diagnostic redaction work that defines the affected behavior.
